_comment: Every photo on the site. Drop the file in assets/photos/ and add an entry here. 'place' decides where it appears: hero-seal | story-lead | story-pair | grow-grid | band | buy. 'tile' is its size in the mosaic gallery: wide | tall | big. 'gallery': false keeps a photo out of the mosaic. 'fullBleed': true lets a band photo span the whole viewport instead of the 1060px column.

photos.alt: The Godfather Organic Farm seal — a pharaonic Horus falcon in gold and inlaid stone, framed by olive branches
Mr. Rezk seated in a chair on the open ground of Wadi Sa'al beside the farm wellhead, an Egyptian flag flying behind him and coiled irrigation hose on the sand

caption.en: Mr. Rezk at the wellhead in Wadi Sa'al, irrigation line still coiled behind him.
caption.ar: الأستاذ رزق عند رأس البئر في وادي سعال، وخراطيم الري ما زالت ملفوفة خلفه.

photos.alt: Alaa and his father together outdoors in Wadi Sa'al with an Egyptian flag beside them

caption.en: The Godfather and his son Alaa, on the land at Wadi Sa'al.
caption.ar: الجودفاذر وابنه علاء، على الأرض في وادي سعال.

photos.alt: Alaa Rezk standing behind a table of packed tomatoes and peppers in Saint Catherine, holding a sign reading Organic vegetables, 0% chemicals, picked today from St. Catherine

caption.en: Alaa at the stall in Saint Catherine, with the morning's picking.
caption.ar: علاء أمام الطاولة في سانت كاترين، ومعه محصول الصباح.

photos.alt: Tomato plant with ripe and green fruit on a drip-irrigated bed
Red bell peppers ripening inside a polytunnel

caption.en: Red bell peppers, left to ripen

photos.alt: Green bell pepper on the plant
Red chilli pepper growing beside a black drip line
Long pale green chilli on a young plant inside a hoop tunnel
Aubergine growing on red soil beside a hoop tunnel, with a granite peak behind the farm

caption.en: Aubergine on the wadi floor — the tunnels and the mountain behind them.
caption.ar: باذنجان في قاع الوادي — الأنفاق والجبل خلفها.

photos.alt: Trays of tomatoes, bell peppers and long green chillies packed on a wooden table

caption.en: A morning's picking, packed and ready to go down the mountain.
caption.ar: محصول صباح واحد، مُعبّأ وجاهز للنزول من الجبل.
